description: Alvore Finance is the workspace where financial consultants and their business clients keep the numbers an engagement runs on. With this app you can ask about a company's P&L, indicators, budget and categorized transactions for any month; review an individual client's overview, household budget and transactions; and read the consulting deliverables attached to each engagement, or publish a new one. Reads cover company and personal finance. Writes only create or update project content — a project, its briefing, an HTML deliverable and its versions — inside the client's private workspace. No tool initiates or settles a payment, transfer or purchase, and nothing the app writes is published to a public address.

defaultPrompt: Mostre a DRE da minha empresa no último trimestre e aponte onde o custo subiu.
Quebre as despesas da empresa por categoria no mês passado e compare com o mês anterior.
